name: Iseya Arata
source:
He's had an 'undesirable relationship' with the protagonist since he was young. A little like an older brother.
Because of that they know things about each other like who their first love was and how many people they've each dated.
But after university they grew apart.
He's always smiling and is popular at his workplace.
